Models

List the models a key may use, with their prices, and read the public catalogue without a key.

GET /v1/models lists what this key may route to, in the OpenAI list shape. Each entry carries a massrelay object with the provider, the custody mode (whose key pays the provider), the family, the prices per million tokens where a rate is known, and the reasoning options where the catalogue states them. A model the workspace brought itself says ownedBy: workspace. Aliases are listed after the models and are marked alias; an alias is a name that routes, never a real model.

Today the listing is served for keys on the L1 routing layer; other key layers get a 501 not_ported answer rather than a guess.

Without a key

GET /public/models and GET /public/models/{provider}/{model} need no credential. They show the catalogue with the price per million input and output tokens and, on the detail page, latency and uptime. A figure backed by too few calls is null, never a small number. Partner models appear with partner: true.

A catalogue generated from the provider feeds (GM-1) is coming; today the catalogue is the one the router ships.

The doors of this chapter

GET /v1/models

Who may call: relay key (bearer).

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written. Mirrors the OpenAI list-models shape (https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/models/list, read 2026-10-11) plus the massrelay extension block, read against models_inner in crates/mr-gateway/src/routes.rs. Served for an L1 key; any other key layer answers 501 not_ported. The massrelay keys listed are those the handler inserts; a key appears only when its source row exists.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "object",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object": {
      "const": "list"
    },
    "data": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "object"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "A model id, or an alias name (after the models)."
          },
          "object": {
            "const": "model"
          },
          "massrelay": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true,
            "properties": {
              "provider": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "custody": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "family": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "reasoning_options": {},
              "price_bands": {
                "type": "array"
              },
              "ownedBy": {
                "const": "workspace",
                "description": "Present only for the workspace's own model."
              },
              "inputUsdPerM": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "outputUsdPerM": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "alias": {
                "const": true,
                "description": "Present on an alias entry."
              },
              "startTier": {},
              "preferOwnModels": {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

GET /public/models

Who may call: public, no credential.

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written, read against public_models_list in crates/mr-server/src/public_models.rs. No credential. 404 when the public pages are switched off. `floor` is the k-floor: a figure backed by fewer calls is null, never a small number.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "floor",
    "models"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "floor": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "models": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "provider",
          "model",
          "partner"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "provider": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "model": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "family": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "contextWindow": {
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "priceInputPerMillionUsd": {
            "type": [
              "number",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "priceOutputPerMillionUsd": {
            "type": [
              "number",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "partner": {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

GET /public/models/{provider}/{model}

Who may call: public, no credential.

Path parameters: provider, model.

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written, read against public_models_detail in crates/mr-server/src/public_models.rs. 404 {error:not_found} for a name the catalogue and the partner listing do not know. Latency and uptime are null below the k-floor.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "provider",
    "model",
    "partner"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "family": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "contextWindow": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "priceInputPerMillionUsd": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "priceOutputPerMillionUsd": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "partner": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "latency": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "p50Ms": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "p95Ms": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "window": {
          "const": "24h"
        }
      }
    },
    "uptime": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "5m": {
          "type": "null"
        },
        "30m": {
          "type": "null"
        },
        "1d": {
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    "floor": {
      "type": "integer"
    }
  }
}
